name: Kentlands

dates.built: Charrette June 1988; construction from 1989; first residents 1991
dates.note: Wikipedia: 'After the June 1988 Kentlands charrette ... Construction started in 1989, and the first model homes opened in mid-1990. The first Kentlands residents moved into new homes in 1991.' The City of Gaithersburg: Helene Danger Kent sold the farm in 1988 to Joseph Alfandre, Jr., who 'hired the land-use planners Andres Duany and Elizabeth Plater-Zyberk'.
